correctness.rationale: For graph K_m square K_2 (m integer >=3), oriented real l1 edge space is R^r + R^r + R^m with r=m(m-1)/2. With clique incidence DD^T=mR, projection P0 onto cycle space and the rank-(m-1) intertwiner H from cut to cycle satisfy P0^2=P0, H^2=0, P0H=H, HP0=0; similarly I-P0+s H^T cuts. S_m×C2 signed edge-isometries split even/odd edge modules; the only common cut/cycle invariant copy is odd mean-zero permutation U0, so every equivariant projection has one parameter. Clique/matching absolute column sums have opposite-slope affine lower support lines; their crossings t=(m-2)(m-4)/(5m-2) and s=(m-2)^2/(m²-m+2) lie within verified sign chambers, giving sharp cycle 16(m-1)^2/[m(5m-2)] and cut 2(m²-m+1)/(m²-m+2). Symmetrization proves global infima, and t=0 only at m4 while s>0 throughout. Independently reconstructed exact Fraction matrix columns, candidate norms and idempotence in m3..8; the all-m proof is algebraic, not finite enumeration.
